title: Conditional 3 Writing-Satzbausteine U3/U4 ohne Travel Blog
designGoal: 100 korrekt kodierte Conditional-3-Satzbausteine fuer Klausur-Writing ohne Travel-Blog-Kontext: Internship Reflection, Museum/Rez/Education, California Opinion/Argument, Advice Email, Review, Report, Comment, Debate und Reflection.
exclusion: Travel blog was intentionally excluded. Past trip/blog-writing tasks are not used as source models; review and reflection contexts remain where they train self-correction, argumentation or report writing.
grammarRule: Conditional 3: if-clause in past perfect; main clause with would/could/might have + past participle. No would in the if-clause.
writingScaffoldRule: Every sentence is reusable as a sentence starter or support sentence for reflection on past alternatives, consequences, missed chances, mistakes, advice, reviews or arguments.

sourceMaterials.use: Write about internship experiences and explain what would/could have been different.
Write about education, community, the rez, museum work and past alternatives.
Write an argument/reflection about California, housing, tech, climate and social problems using past alternatives.
Write advice/reflection about summer camp, parents, arguments and communication using past alternatives.
Write a review, report, comment, debate article or reflection using past hypothetical improvements.

vocabularySources: existing Unit 3/Unit 4 exam, writing, grammar and support transcripts listed in sourceMaterials
